replies.author: @chrislees8951
replies.text: Having visited Stanley numerous times and many of the outer settlements. A lot of people have polytunnels and grow their own produce, keeping chickens is also a common practice. A make do and mend mentality exists. I’ve lived and work in the Islands several times. My family settled in the Falklands in the 1840s many of my extended family are Islanders, they are a resilient, friendly if sometimes cautious community. Which is understandable, they want to live in peace without fear or favour and charter their own course as a country. I’m proud of my heritage.
